pairs: Intelligens autem Joab filius Sarviæ quod cor regis versum esset ad Absalom,
Now Joab, the son of Zeruiah, understood that the heart of the king had been turned toward Absalom,
and he brought from there a wise woman.
and put on the clothing of one who mourns.
And do not anoint yourself with oil,
ut sis quasi mulier jam plurimo tempore lugens mortuum:
so that you may be like a woman who is still grieving for someone who died some time ago.
And you shall enter to the king,
et loqueris ad eum sermones hujuscemodi.
and you shall speak words to him in this manner.”
Posuit autem Joab verba in ore ejus.
Then Joab put the words in her mouth.
Itaque cum ingressa fuisset mulier Thecuitis ad regem,
And so, when the woman of Tekoa had entered to the king,
she fell before him on the ground,
And the king said to her,
I am a woman who is a widow.
Et ancillæ tuæ erant duo filii:
And your handmaid had two sons.
qui rixati sunt adversum se in agro,
And they quarreled against one another in the field.
nullusque erat qui eos prohibere posset:
And there was no one there who would be able to stop them.
Et ecce consurgens universa cognatio adversum ancillam tuam,
And behold, the whole family, rising up against your handmaid,
Trade eum qui percussit fratrem suum,
‘Deliver him who struck down his brother,
ut occidamus eum pro anima fratris sui quem interfecit,
so that we may kill him for the life of his brother, whom he killed,
et deleamus hæredem: et quærunt extinguere scintillam meam quæ relicta est,
and so that we may do away with the heir.’ And they are seeking to extinguish my spark that is left,
ut non supersit viro meo nomen,
so that there may not survive a name for my husband,
nor a remnant upon the earth.”
And the king said to the woman,
and I will make a decree on your behalf.”
And the woman of Tekoa said to the king:
and upon the house of my father.
rex autem et thronus ejus sit innocens.
et ultra non addet ut tangat te.
and he will never touch you again.”
“Let the king remember the Lord his God,
ut non multiplicentur proximi sanguinis ad ulciscendum,
so that close blood relatives may not be multiplied in order to take revenge,
and so that they may by no means kill my son.”
quia non cadet de capillis filii tui super terram.
not one hair from your son shall fall to the ground.”
Loquatur ancilla tua ad dominum meum regem verbum.
“Let your handmaid speak a word to my lord the king.”
Quare cogitasti hujuscemodi rem contra populum Dei,
“Why have you thought such a thing against the people of God,
et locutus est rex verbum istud,
and why has the king spoken this word,
and does not lead back the one whom he rejected?
et quasi aquæ dilabimur in terram, quæ non revertuntur:
and we are all like waters that flow into the ground and do not return.
God does not will to lose a soul. Instead,
sed retractat cogitans ne penitus pereat qui abjectus est.
he renews his efforts, thinking that what has been rejected might not perish altogether.
ut loquar ad dominum meum regem verbum hoc,
now I have come to speak this word to my lord the king,
in the presence of the people.
I will speak to the king,
si quomodo faciat rex verbum ancillæ suæ.
for perhaps there may be some way for the king to accomplish the word of his handmaid.
ut liberaret ancillam suam de manu omnium qui volebant de hæreditate Dei delere me,
and he freed his handmaid from the hand of all who were willing to take away me and my son together,
ut fiat verbum domini mei regis sicut sacrificium.
so that the word of my lord the king may be like a sacrifice.
For even like an Angel of God,
so is my lord the king,
ut nec benedictione, nec maledictione moveatur:
so that he is moved by neither a blessing, nor a curse.
unde et Dominus Deus tuus est tecum.
Then too, the Lord your God is with you.”
the king said to the woman,
Ne abscondas a me verbum quod te interrogo.
“You shall not conceal from me a word of what I ask you.”
And the woman said to him,
Numquid manus Joab tecum est in omnibus istis?
“Is not the hand of Joab with you in all this?”
it is neither to the left,
nec ad dexteram est ex omnibus his quæ locutus est dominus meus rex:
in all these things that my lord the king has spoken.
For your servant Joab himself instructed me,
et ipse posuit in os ancillæ tuæ omnia verba hæc.
and he himself placed all these words in the mouth of your handmaid.
Thus did I turn to this figure of speech,
because your servant Joab instructed it.
just as an Angel of God has wisdom,
so that you understand all that is upon the earth.”
And the king said to Joab:
“Behold, your word has succeeded in appeasing me.
go and call back the boy Absalom.”
Cadensque Joab super faciem suam in terram,
And falling to the ground upon his face,
Hodie intellexit servus tuus quia inveni gratiam in oculis tuis,
“Today your servant has understood that I have found grace in your sight,
For you have accomplished the word of your servant.”
and he went away to Geshur.
And he brought Absalom into Jerusalem.
“Let him return to his own house,
but let him not see my face.”
Reversus est itaque Absalom in domum suam,
And so, Absalom returned to his own house,
but he did not see the face of the king.
vir non erat pulcher in omni Israël, et decorus nimis:
there was no man so handsome, and so very stately as Absalom.
a vestigio pedis usque ad verticem non erat in eo ulla macula.
From the sole of the foot to the top of the head, there was no blemish in him.
Et quando tondebat capillum (semel autem in anno tondebatur,
And when he shaved off his hair, for he shaved it off once a year,
because his long hair was burdensome to him,
ponderabat capillos capitis sui ducentis siclis,
he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels,
Nati sunt autem Absalom filii tres,
Then three sons were born to Absalom,
and one daughter, of elegant form,
Mansitque Absalom in Jerusalem duobus annis,
And Absalom remained for two years in Jerusalem,
and he did not see the face of the king.
And so, he sent to Joab,
so that he might send him to the king.
But he refused to come to him.
And when he had sent a second time,
et ille noluisset venire ad eum,
and he had refused to come to him,
Scitis agrum Joab juxta agrum meum,
“You know that the field of Joab,
the one that is near my field,
Therefore, go and set it on fire.”
Succenderunt ergo servi Absalom segetem igni.
And so, the servants of Absalom set fire to the grain field.
arriving with their garments torn, said,
Succenderunt servi Absalom partem agri igni.
“The servants of Absalom have set fire to part of the field!”
et venit ad Absalom in domum ejus,
and he went to Absalom at his house,
Quare succenderunt servi tui segetem meam igni?
“Why have your servants set fire to my grain field?”
Misi ad te obsecrans ut venires ad me,
“I sent to you, begging that you might come to me,
and that I might send you to the king,
and that you might say to him:
It would have been better for me to be there.’
obsecro ergo ut videam faciem regis:
I beg you, therefore, that I may see the face of the king.
quod si memor est iniquitatis meæ,
And if he is mindful of my iniquity,
let him put me to death.”
And so, Joab, entering to the king,
And he entered to the king,
et adoravit super faciem terræ coram eo:
and he reverenced on the face of the earth.
